title: Local Tseitin clause assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, let $w$ be a natural number, and let $a\in\{\pm1\}^n$ be an assignment. For each clause index $i$ of $F$, the local assignment on $n+(w-3)|F|$ variables is obtained by filling the lifted literals of clause $i$ and its auxiliary literals into the base assignment.
caveat: The definitions of the Tseitin lifting, auxiliary literals, and filling operation are not supplied, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be rendered.
